text: True or False: By 2021, PsiQuantum had raised more private capital (roughly $665M) than most of the photonic AI sector combined.
explanation: True. The chapter states PsiQuantum had raised roughly $665M by 2021, more than most of the photonic AI sector combined, later supplemented by government partnerships in Australia and the US, because a discontinuous fault-tolerant prize attracts the largest single rounds.
